name: jobhunt-os
description: Local-first job hunting app: fetch listings, score against your resume with Claude, tailor materials, track applications.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web
